title: SecuraCV device manifest
description: One manifest per Canary device (devices/<slug>/device.json). It JOINS facts that already live in seven other schemas — it does not restate them. Every key here is cross-checked against its source of truth by scripts/lint_device_manifests.py, and the confidence-ladder verdict is NEVER typed here: it is derived from canary-local/devices/figures.json evidence and printed by the linter. A key whose value is unknown is omitted, not guessed.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; relative path to this schema.

slug.description: Directory name under devices/. Where a build_matrix.json product or a flash.json product (minus its securacv- prefix) names this hardware, the slug is that id.

name.description: Human product name as the flasher catalog shows it.

family.description: The firmware product this device is built from: a `name` in firmware/flavors.json (canary, canary-wap, canary-vision, canary-display, canary-sense).

mcu.description: esptool's chip identity string — the same vocabulary as flash.json `chips` and boards.json `mcu`.

board_id.description: The firmware/boards/<id>/ registry row (boards.json id) whose pins/pins.h describes this hardware.

variants.description: Other boards.json ids that are SKU variants of the same panel module, whose pins headers some of this device's envs compile against (the Dash 4.3 / 4.3B / 4.3C). Peripherals are still proven against board_id only.

envs.description: Every PlatformIO [env:NAME] of the family that targets this hardware: the flavors.json build_envs it claims plus any env build_matrix.json / flash.json names as the shipped image.

peripherals.description: Lower-cased HAS_<NAME> capability flags the board_id pins header sets to 1 (camera, microphone, sd_card, display, touch, rtc, battery, mmwave_radar, ...). Only what the header proves; connectivity intrinsics (wifi, ble, usb_cdc, psram) are not listed.

figure.description: The canary-local/devices/figures.json figure id (role `device`) that draws this hardware. Its `confidence` is the ladder verdict for this device — read it there; never copy it here.

scad.description: The primary OpenSCAD source of this device's enclosure.

enclosure_sets.description: canary-local/devices/enclosures.json `sets[].id` entries printable for this hardware; `scad` must be the source of at least one of them.

flavor.description: canary-local/emulator/build.sh flavor whose dist/canary-display-<flavor>.js is this device's firmware compiled to WebAssembly. Only flavors in build.sh's allowlist; only canary-display devices have one today.

product.description: The canary-local/devices/flash.json `products[].id` the browser flasher offers for this hardware.

variants.description: Further flash.json products that install onto this same hardware (a wellbeing build, a modes build). Every flash.json product is claimed by exactly one manifest, as product or variant.

page.description: Website (securacv_website) page for this device. Lives in another repository: the linter checks the shape only.

model.description: Website glTF model for the AR viewer. Lives in another repository: the linter checks the shape only.
